title: The Human Nervous System
text: The nervous system coordinates the body's actions and sensory information, comprising the central nervous system (brain and spinal cord) and the peripheral nervous system (nerves branching throughout the body). Neurons transmit electrical and chemical signals. The brain processes sensory input, controls voluntary and involuntary functions, and enables cognition, memory, and emotion. The autonomic nervous system regulates involuntary functions such as heart rate and digestion.
